[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Eth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]], he was stationed at [[Thesh Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Hailstorm" />
